dct_title_s: Decatur County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol AJE; form of individual image numbering: AJE-1-[number], AJE-2-[number], AJE-3-[number], or AJE-4-[number]. "Date of completion 11-26-37". Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
